description: Repairs r-err-1b/proto-* (repeat-A cases): every case repeated the same failure A, and the intermediate success was always a read, so repeat-A could not separate 'replace' from 'keep'; only the pair with different text and the same number 3078 discriminated. Failures with different Numbers: Errors read; A = Database.Execute('SELEC ID FROM P'), Errors read; B = OpenRecordset('SELECT NoCol FROM P') (snapshot), Errors read; C = TableDefs.Item('NoSuchTable'), Errors read; a successful snapshot OpenRecordset of Q (closed), Errors read; D = Database.Execute('DROP TABLE P'), Errors read. Then A and B back to back with no Errors read between them, Errors read. Asks whether a later failure with a different Number replaces, adds to or leaves the earlier entry, and what a success does to the entry. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
